rows.note: For a naive or foolish person, this is the all-purpose colloquial choice.

example.english: You’re so easily fooled; you’re really a sap.
example.traditional: 你咁容易畀人呃，真係個傻仔。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 jung4 ji6 bei2 jan4 ngaak1 zan1 hai6 go3 so4 zai2

rows.note: Use this for the fluid inside a plant, especially when discussing trees or plant biology.

example.english: Plants rely on sap to transport nutrients.
example.jyutping: zik6 mat6 kaau3 syu6 jik6 syu1 sung3 joeng5 fan6

rows.note: Use this for a short club or handheld blunt weapon rather than an ordinary walking stick.

example.english: The robber rushed into the shop holding a sap.
example.traditional: 賊人揸住支短棍衝入舖頭。
example.jyutping: caak6 jan4 zaa1 zyu6 zi1 dyun2 gwan3 cung1 jap6 pou3 tau2
